topics.fact: The mantis shrimp can punch so fast that the water next to its claw boils into a brief bubble that collapses with a flash of light and a small shockwave.
topics.subject: Mantis shrimp and cavitation

topics.fact: Sloths often grow green algae in their fur, which gives them a greenish tint and helps them blend into the canopy.
topics.subject: Sloth fur ecosystem

topics.fact: Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing in 1969 than to the building of the Great Pyramid of Giza.
topics.subject: Ancient Egypt timeline

topics.fact: Oxford University was already teaching students roughly 200 years before the Aztec capital of Tenochtitlan was founded in 1325.
topics.subject: Medieval universities and Mesoamerica

topics.fact: The footprints left by Apollo astronauts on the Moon could last millions of years, because there is no wind or rain to erode them.
topics.subject: Lunar surface and erosion
